name: Oze Nanaha
source:
Megumi's daughter. Swimming club member.
Unlike her mother, she's active and energetic. And a bit scatterbrained.
Tends to get in trouble due to a habit of hastily jumping to conclusions.
Her hard work in the club activities doesn't reflect on her body, making her worry about her development.
